column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 2 - Summer Comiket Arc
W-We finally got in.
Yeah.
Woah... It's hot in here as well.
Should we take a little break? I know we just got in, but I'm sure you're tired from queuing in the heat.
N-No... I'm fine.
There's no need to rush. It's not like we're here for the events and merchandise anyway...
Let's just walk around at our own pace.
But... If Kirino was here, she wouldn't stop to rest, would she?
You got that right.
If it's her, she'd probably head straight for the east hall to get the books she's after. Or she might head to the west hall where the commercial booths are.
In that case... We should do the same.
All this in an attempt to understand Kirino better...
Alright. Let's go.
Ah!
Woah! Watch your step!
Y-Yes...
Ah!
Are you okay?
Y-Yes...
Oh, Ayase. Whether it's because we're surrounded by otaku or because she's nervous being here for the first time, she's unusually absent-minded.
Here.
Eh?
Let's hold hands so we don't get separated.
N-No way!
It's not that big a deal, is it?!
That definitely won't do... Besides, my hands are all sweaty.
Hold on to my sleeve at least. Kirino did that last year.
...Like this?
Yeah.
First we headed to the fourth hall in the western section.
Various circles had lined up their stalls in the vast area.
This is where they sell doujinshi. You could say it's the main part of 【Summer Comiket】.
I don't really understand this doujinshi market thing you mentioned...
All these tables, do you mean...
Yeah, they're selling doujinshi.
...Amazing.
I know, right?
Saori would call this a "festival created by everyone".
Ayase and I aren't here to buy anything in particular, so we're just strolling around.
Ah... Isn't that a Meruru book which Kirino likes so much?
Seems like it. Shall we go take a look?
Um... I just realized this, but... what if Kirino is here as well?
Now that you mention it, I never asked what she's doing today. It's possible.
W-Wouldn't that be bad?!
Nah, it's fine. With this many people around, we won't run into her.
Alright, finished surveying the stalls along the edges. Up next is...
What's wrong?
...Nothing. Although it's unlikely, let's play it safe and avoid the Meruru stalls.
Y-You're right.
Oh, that looks like a Maschera stall!
Maschera?
It's an anime. I kinda like it. Mind taking a look?
Okay.
We turned and walked towards a stand belonging to a Maschera doujin circle called Lonely Cat.
Doesn't this main character kind of look like me?
Which one?
This one.
You're not quite that handsome, Onii-san.
Hey, try to play along! You're hurting me.
I'm sorry. But... Haha.
What?
You even said you're not that much of an otaku.
Onii-san, what you just said sounded very much like an otaku.
R-Really?
Yes.
...A-Am I disgusting?
Yes. Very much so.
You don't have to be so frank.
*sigh* So that's how it is.
When did I turn into such a disgusting otaku?
I don't hate it though.
Eh?
...Would you two stop flirting in front of my stand?
